milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mined purple wool drops as an item and ends up in the player's inventory. The agent needs at least 8 blocks to build a 2x2x2 cube. Wool breaks by hand and drops itself, so no tool is required.

Uses count_in_box_at_most to verify original wool is fully mined (0 blocks remaining at original location), AND count_in_box_at_least to verify 8+ purple_wool blocks exist on the platform (confirming a 2x2x2 cube was built). The two-rule approach prevents false positives from unmined original blocks while allowing the agent to build anywhere on the platform.
